I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random. I said I've noted that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats and that I won't take any action, as he asked. I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team, since that's where the wrong number went up.

I didn't need to look anything up. I didn't open #central-team or repeat this morning's figure in #central-random, because people in this channel may not be able to see that one. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
